why: Page teardown leaves the route host's painter subscribed to the machine it built. The two die together in production, so nothing visible breaks -- which is exactly why the symmetry with a session's own unsubscribe is pinned rather than trusted: a reference kept past `pagehide` would keep painting a disposed HUD. 1 of 38 in route-host.test.ts: the disposal case that changes the route after `dispose()` and expects no paint.
